import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] ones = new long[17];

    static int solve(long n, int i) {
        int t = i * (int)(n / ones[i]);
        n %= ones[i];
        if (n == 0) return t;
        return t + Math.min(i + solve(ones[i] - n, i - 1), solve(n, i - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ones[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(solve(n, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
